verdict.rationale: Cooley has a dedicated Patent Counseling and Prosecution practice page documenting a global team of 100+ lawyers/professionals with PhDs and advanced engineering degrees serving as patent counsel to 3,500+ companies, directly matching the drafting/filing/portfolio strategy story, supplemented by IP litigation stats showing downstream enforcement of the patent positions built. Missing for 10: named individual practitioner bios/profiles are not included in the pack, and no independent/hands-on corroboration of prosecution quality beyond firm-published statistics.
